## [2026-07-31] correction+reports | BOOK RECUT ON THE LIVE CADENCE (user: "recoupe le backtest et le monte carlo sur la cadence live"). While implementing it I found my previous-turn attribution was WRONG and incomplete: the gap between the exploratory IBS loop and the deployed driver is not one artefact (same-bar re-entry) but **three**, all from the loop running its entry test AFTER the exit block of the same bar and testing the exit on the CURRENT bar instead of the last closed one: (a) it can re-enter on the very bar a stop fired, filling at that bar's OPEN = a price already in the past; (b) it NEVER tests the exit on the entry bar (it enters at the bottom of that iteration), so a signal exit needs >=2 bars while the driver, seeing the entry bar close at the next rollover, can exit after ONE; (c) it resolves the stop of bar t before considering an entry on bar t. Verified the live cadence reproduces the driver replay trade-for-trade.
